newsitem.title: USA: EA Industries sees second-half profitability.
newsitem.headline: EA Industries sees second-half profitability.

text.p: EA Industries Inc said on Thursday it expects higher sales to boost it to profitability in the second half of 1997.
EA Industries reported a first-quarter net loss of $0.35 per share, compared with a loss of $0.93 per share for the same period the year before.
The company attributed the loss to a decrease in sales to its three largest customers, but forecast that orders to these customers would pick up in the second half of the year.
EA Industries, through its subsidiary Tanon Manufacturing, services the electronics industry as a contract manufacturer. Its shares were down 1/4 to 2-7/8 in afternoon trading.
